'''Ovidiu Vasile Savin''' (born January 1, 1977) is a Romanian-American [[mathematician]] who is active in the field of the [[partial differential equation]]s.

==Scientific activity==
Savin received his Ph.D. in mathematics from the [[University of Texas at Austin]] in 2003 having [[Luis Caffarelli]] as advisor; he is
professor of mathematics at [[Columbia University]].
Savin is mostly known for his important work on [[Ennio De Giorgi]]'s conjecture about global solutions to certain semilinear equations, that he proved up to dimension 8.<ref>{{cite journal|first=Ovidiu|last=Savin|title=Regularity of flat level sets in phase transitions|url=http://annals.math.princeton.edu/2009/169-1/p02|journal=[[Annals of Mathematics]]|series=2|volume=169 |year=2009|issue=1|pages= 41–78|doi=10.4007/annals.2009.169.41| mr=2480601|doi-access=free|url-access=subscription}}</ref> It is to be noticed that the conjecture turns out to be false in higher dimensions, as eventually proved by Manuel del Pino, Michał Kowalczyk, and [[Juncheng Wei]].<ref>{{cite journal|first1=Manuel |last1=del Pino|first2= Michał |last2=Kowalczyk|first3=Juncheng|last3=Wei|author3-link= Juncheng Wei|title=On De Giorgi's conjecture in dimension N ≥ 9| url=http://annals.math.princeton.edu/2011/174-3/p03|journal=[[Annals of Mathematics]]|series=2|volume= 174 |year=2011|issue= 3|pages= 1485–1569|mr=2846486 |doi=10.4007/annals.2011.174.3.3|doi-access=free|hdl=10533/137649|hdl-access=free}}</ref> Savin has also worked on various regularity questions proving the gradient continuity of solutions to the infinity-Laplacian equation in two dimensions and obtaining results on the boundary regularity of solutions to the [[Monge–Ampère equation]].

==Recognition==
Savin won a gold medal with a perfect score in the 1995 [[International Mathematical Olympiad]].<ref>{{cite web|title=International Mathematical Olympiad|url=https://www.imo-official.org/participant_r.aspx?id=3790|website=www.imo-official.org|accessdate=8 August 2016}}</ref> As an undergraduate at the [[University of Pittsburgh]] in 1997, Savin was a [[William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition]] fellow.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.maa.org/awards/putnam.html|title=The Mathematical Association of America's William Lowell Putnam Competition|accessdate=May 11, 2013|archive-date=February 29, 2000|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20000229230334/http://www.maa.org/awards/putnam.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>  Savin was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2006.<ref>{{cite web|title=International Congress of Mathematicians 2006|url=http://www.icm2006.org/|accessdate=May 5, 2013}}</ref> He was awarded the [[Stampacchia Medal]] in 2012.
